summary: Diagnosed and fixed the "session too small" error: Pi's whole-turn compaction cut refused on the 70% session because everything since the last summary was a single turn. Added `compactRequested()` in `apps/agent-server/src/sessions/compaction-fallback.ts` that prefers a whole-turn cut and retries with `{ splitTurns: true }` when Pi throws "Nothing to compact", wired it into `session-operations.compact`, added tests (240 passing, tsc clean), and restarted the supervised live server.
decisions: Manual compaction (`session.compact`) now goes through `compactRequested()` which tries the user's whole-turn policy first and, only on a "Nothing to compact" error from Pi, retries once with `splitTurns: true` before restoring the original policy — preserving whole-turn semantics when possible while unblocking sessions whose kept tail is one whole turn.
The Pi SDK was left as-is; the fallback lives entirely in Gizmo so no further patches or lockfile churn are needed.
Live server restart strategy remains `taskkill /T /F` against the supervised `scripts\web-server.ts run` processes (relaunch ~17s); app build was not touched because only server code changed.
errors: `prepareCompaction` is not exported from `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`'s package root, and the `dist/core/compaction/compaction.js` subpath is not in `exports`, so the repro script had to import it via an absolute `file:///C:/Users/...` URL (Git Bash `/c/` and bare `C:/` paths both failed under tsx).

Original `compact()` would throw on this session shape because Pi's whole-turn cut returns no messages to summarize and no prefix to keep; confirmed by running `prepareCompaction` on the live session file: `fullTurn=true` → undefined at retain 10/20/30%, `fullTurn=false` → ok with split prefix 251/213/163 messages.
